{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend coat, tailored straight cut, hip-length (mid-thigh), charcoal gray #2F353B, heavy wool with a brushed interior.
Cotton sweater, relaxed boatneck silhouette, hip-length body with long sleeves, cream white #FFFDD0, fine-gauge knit for warmth against the frost.
High-waisted denim jeans, classic straight-leg fit, full length reaching the ankle, deep indigo #191970, durable stone-wash cotton to handle the snowy conditions without showing salt stains.
Chunky leather-look sneakers, robust boxy design with a thick tread sole, matte black #1C1C1C, water-resistant synthetic upper designed to keep feet dry and warm while walking on snow-covered, salted paths.

This outfit works because it prioritizes genuine warmth and safety against the harsh winter conditions of frost and snow, ensuring her comfort during a twenty-minute walk. The neutral palette of charcoal, cream, and deep indigo harmonizes beautifully with her warm skin tones and dark hair, creating a cohesive look that feels intentional rather than just bundled up. While denim is technically everyday wear, this specific construction elevates the silhouette to meet the practical needs of a frosty autumn day without sacrificing style or comfort."}
